content.title: What are EnumSet & EnumMap?
content.description: EnumSet is a specialized Set implementation designed exclusively for enum types, while EnumMap is a specialized Map implementation that uses enum constants as keys. Both are highly optimized for performance and memory efficiency.

content.content: The Java Collections Framework provides EnumSet and EnumMap specifically for working with enum types. Since they are optimized internally using bit vectors and arrays, they are significantly faster and more memory-efficient than general-purpose collections like HashSet and HashMap when dealing with enums.

content.title: Why Use Enum Collections?
content.content: EnumSet and EnumMap provide better performance, lower memory usage, and compile-time type safety when working with enumeration constants.
EnumSet is a high-performance implementation of the Set interface that stores only enum constants. Duplicate values are automatically ignored.

content.content: EnumMap is a specialized implementation of the Map interface where every key must be an enum constant. Values can be any object type.

content.title: EnumMap Example
Performance
content.content: EnumMap is generally faster than HashMap when enum constants are used as keys.

content.title: Calendar Planner
content.content: Think of an EnumMap as a weekly planner where each day of the week (enum key) has a scheduled activity (value). EnumSet is like selecting only the working days from the entire week.

content.title: Interview Importance
content.content: Interviewers may ask when to prefer EnumSet over HashSet, EnumMap over HashMap, their internal implementation, performance advantages, and common use cases involving enums.

items.question: Can EnumSet store String values?
items.answer: No. EnumSet stores only enum constants.

items.question: Can EnumMap use String as a key?
items.answer: No. EnumMap keys must always be enum constants.

items.question: Should HashMap always be used instead of EnumMap?
items.answer: No. EnumMap is preferred when keys are enums because it offers better performance and memory efficiency.

content.title: Remember This
content.description: Use EnumSet for collections of enum values and EnumMap for mapping enum constants to objects. They are faster and more efficient than HashSet and HashMap for enum-based data.
